therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Cord Blood-derived Expanded Allogeneic Natural Killer Cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity enhanced by rituximab-mediated antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Direct tumor cell killing and immune-mediated tumor clearance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with recurrent or refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma

results.dose_information: NK cells given IV, rituximab given IV, high-dose chemotherapy regimen including carmustine IV, cytarabine IV, etoposide IV, melphalan IV, lenalidomide PO
